heroHeadline:
UAP Disclosure:
PURSUE Reaches 338 Files as Science Advisory Council, Disclosure Forum Advance Institutional Push
heroSubtitle: Tracking official government actions, congressional hearings, declassified documents, and institutional statements on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena. June 9: David Grusch and bipartisan House members (Burlison, Luna, Burchett, Moskowitz) held their announced Capitol steps press conference, with Grusch alleging billions in unaccounted 'slush fund' spending and accusing the DIA of oversight obstruction. PURSUE Tranche 3 (June 12, 72 files) detailed a Western US orb incident; Tranche 4 (July 10, 40 files) included the 2015 Pantex nuclear-facility drone intrusion — bringing the program total to 338 declassified files across four tranches. June 14: the White House formed a 12-member UAP Science Advisory Council chaired by Harvard's Avi Loeb. June 25: the Disclosure Foundation's first Disclosure Forum 2026 drew Sens. Rounds and Gillibrand plus House task-force members, with Rounds pledging to revive the UAP Disclosure Act after its third straight NDAA exclusion. Next EO milestone: 300-day full-disclosure-or-justify deadline in late Nov/Dec 2026.
footerNote: This tracker documents official statements, legislative actions, and institutional processes related to UAP disclosure. It does not validate or endorse the claims contained within official testimonies. EDITORIAL NOTE: Events record that officials made specific claims — not that those claims are verified as factually true. All contested claims include opposing positions.
